top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 discovery chain (Holst on incretin physiology and proglucagon processing, Drucker on receptor biology and metabolic actions, Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) explains why degradation-resistant agonists work, and large independent trials have confirmed effects on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes, so the work is mature. The three-name allocation keeps credit on discovery scientists. Mojsov's priority is contested and unverified from the supplied material, but it does not justify no award.
